o.text: From Turkish fok, from French phoque.
From Proto-Turkic *bar- (“to walk, go; to come, reach”). Cognate with Turkish varmak, Uzbek bormoq, Chuvash пыр (pyr), etc.
Internationalism; via Russian идеоло́гия (ideológija), from French idéologie.
